description: Oxford Crossing is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located at 101-123 Sutton Avenue in Oxford, Massachusetts, serving the local community with essential retail and services. Managed by Capital Group Properties, this well-maintained center provides residents of Oxford and surrounding Worcester County communities with easy access to everyday shopping needs. The center's strategic location along Sutton Avenue ensures high visibility and accessibility for local shoppers seeking convenient retail options.
